'''Need Nunb''' was the third cousin of [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]]. Nunb operated the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Need's Mead]] in the [[Sullust/Legends|Sullustan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fulluusub]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
